CREATE TABLE EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT_DATE_V2

(

					, '2024/07/01', '2024/08/01', '2024/09/01', '2024/10/01', '2024/11/01', '2024/12/01'
					, '2025/01/01', '2025/02/01', '2025/03/01', '2025/04/01', '2025/05/01', '2025/06/01'					
				) 
			)
, HEAP
)

    WHEN LEFT(FACT.CIF_ID,1) = 'R' then 'Retail'

,YTD.YTD_BALANCE
,YTD.YTD_BALANCE_PHP
FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT FACT
INNER JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_MTD_YTD_UAT YTD
ON FACT.GAM_ACID = YTD.GAM_ACID
AND FACT.AS_OF_DATE = YTD.FULLDATE
WHERE 1 = 2
